defect.rule: Each source_span must preserve the occurrence and its stated arguments/side condition; every argument_span therefore must lie inside the source_span used for that occurrence.
defect.finding: The historical exact-span verifier checked body.includes(argument_span) but did not check source_span.includes(argument_span). Historical cold-audit completeness records therefore cannot by themselves authorize G2.

repair_rule: For each affected occurrence, preserve every field except source_span and replace source_span with the unique shortest contiguous substring of the frozen body enclosing the predecessor source_span and every declared argument_span. If the minimum enclosure is non-unique, do not repair mechanically.
